_meta.what_this_is: A before/after eval of two learned skills. 20 tasks, each solved by the agent with a baseline prompt and again with a candidate skill added. Each string is 20 pass/fail marks (1 pass, 0 fail), in task order t01..t20 — PAIRED, because the same tasks are run both ways. The question: does adding the skill improve outcomes enough to keep it?
_meta.results_are: A FIXTURE standing in for real agent runs. Hand-authored so skill_A is a genuine improvement and skill_B looks active (it changes 11 tasks) but nets almost nothing. Point the ratchet at your own before/after runs.
_meta.skill_A: a grounding hint: helps 9 tasks, hurts 1 -> net +8 of 20
_meta.skill_B: a verbose-format nudge: helps 6 tasks, hurts 5 -> net +1 of 20, inside the noise
